location_description: Darien ( dair-ee-AN) is a coastal town in Fairfield County, Connecticut, United States. With a population of 21,499 and a land area of just under 13 square miles, it is the smallest town on Connecticut's Gold Coast.  It has the youngest population of any non-college town in Connecticut, a high rate of marriage, and high number of average children per household.
